title: REAL EVIDENCE REQUIRED — condensation vs penetrating damp decided from photographs
why: Only genuine inspection photographs can test whether the model reads a staining pattern (defined edge, tide mark, blistering) versus black-spot mould on cold surfaces. Synthetic images cannot stand in for this. A practising surveyor supplies or approves the photographs and confirms the expected reading.

must_not_happen.label: no definitive cause where the photographs show both patterns

reviewer_notes: TO COMPLETE: place anonymised photographs under server/evals/fixtures/REAL/C-001/, fill in the surveyor's note/transcript as recorded, set calibration.truth to the cause the surveyor holds on the balance of probabilities, then change status to runnable. Photographs must not show faces, documents, or addresses.
